title: Uncraftable Items Recipes
body:
# 🧱 Uncraftable Item Recipes – Craft the Impossible Why let rare loot stay locked behind RNG and boss fights? This datapack breaks the boundaries and lets you craft the untouchables — from elytra to enchanted apples, all with balanced recipes that keep survival gameplay fair and fun. # 🔥 Craft Recipes For: - Chainmail armour ✅ - Elytra ✅ - Enchanted golden apple ✅ - Dragon egg ✅ - Nether Star ✅ - Sponges ✅ - Heavy core ✅ - Trial keys ✅ - Ominous Trial keys ✅ - Name tags ✅ - Horse armour leather ✅ - Horse armour gold ✅ - Horse armour diamond ✅ - Bedrock ✅ - Ominous potion ✅ - bottle of xp ✅ - Sculk ✅ - Sculk catalyst ✅ - Sculk sensor ✅ - Sculk shrieker ✅ - Sculk Vein ✅ - Vault ✅ - Reinforced deepslate ✅ - Monster spawner ✅ - Calcite ✅ - String ✅ - Saddle ✅ - Bell ✅ ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **_Note_** :If you are **interested in more Datapacks or want any specific recipes only**check out the links at the **end** of the **description** and **download the ones you prefer**. **🧠 Why It’s Better:** Because survival shouldn’t mean suffering. This pack gives you control without breaking the game. It’s perfect for hardcore players, casual builders. 📦 How to Use: 1. Download the .zip 2. Drop it into your world’s datapacks/ folder 3. Type /reload in-game 4. Start crafting your comeback [Gallery with recipes coming soon] Try out some more datapacks if you wish:
